name: Graphite (natural)
note: Brazil is a top-3 producer; Chinese export controls from Dec 2023.
uses: Anodes of lithium-ion batteries, refractories, lubricants, brake linings, steelmaking electrodes.
why_it_matters: Natural graphite anodes are processed almost entirely in China, whose export controls of 2023 covered graphite; Brazil is one of the few other large producers.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures
